text: Land Encounters And Points Of Interest

Fills the campaign map with places worth a detour.\\n\\nEncounters: spots that hold a battle or a treasure site. A battle can come with offers to tip it, missions that pay out if met, battle modifiers and a pick of spoils. A treasure site offers its own special and two more choices.\\n\\nTowers: one per zone. Delve floor by floor for a growing haul, and pick an offer after every win. Lose a floor and you lose the haul.\\n\\nSmithies: claim one for free items and tribute, commission masterworks and upgrade the forge. Enemies at war with you can besiege it.\\n\\nTaverns: hire mercenaries, take contracts from the Tavern Keepers' Guild and try your luck at the bar.\\n\\nBoons and Curses: lords carry lasting boons that grow as they win, and curses that worsen until a Smithy or the Tavern's hedge-witch lifts them.\\n\\nEach feature has its own page here to turn it off or tune it, with a guide to how it works.\\n\\nBuilt on diagonal_zero's Land Encounters, which brought Anyndel's sea encounters onto land.
